specs.Compatible Devices: iPhone 17/16/15 Series, Galaxy S25/S24 Ultra, and other Type-C phones, tablets, and notebooks

features: FLAGSHIP DAC & AMPLIFIER FOR SUPERIOR SOUND QUALITY: AUDIOCULAR SPARK features the industry-leading CX31993 DAC chip paired with the powerful MAX97220 headphone amplifier. This combination delivers rich, elastic low frequencies, smooth and sweet midrange vocals, and crystal-clear high frequencies without any distortion or harshness. Experience balanced, detailed sound reproduction that brings your music, movies, and games to life with pristine clarity and depth.

HIGH-RESOLUTION AUDIO SUPPORT FOR TRUE FIDELITY: Supporting PCM 32bit/384kHz and ADC 24bit/96kHz, the SPARK enables high-resolution audio playback that captures every nuance and subtle detail in your favorite tracks. With a remarkable signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) above 124dB, it ensures a clean, immersive listening experience free from background noise or interference.

PORTABLE AND COMPACT DESIGN FOR ON-THE-GO LISTENING: Designed to be lightweight and mini-sized, the AUDIOCULAR SPARK is easy to carry wherever you go. It fits comfortably in your pocket or bag, making it the perfect companion for travel, commuting, or outdoor use—enhancing audio quality on smartphones, tablets, and notebooks with Type-C ports.

SEAMLESS TYPE-C TO 3.5MM CONNECTIVITY: The SPARK acts as a bridge between your device Type-C output and traditional 3.5mm headphones, improving sound output without sacrificing detail. Compatible with headphones ranging from 16 to 32Ω impedance, it delivers powerful 63mW output at 32Ω, boosting your audio performance for a richer listening experience.

PREMIUM MATERIALS FOR DURABILITY AND OPTIMAL PERFORMANCE: Constructed with an 8-strand braided single crystal copper silver-plated cable and featuring a gold-plated 3.5mm interface, the SPARK ensures superior conductivity and long-lasting durability. The meticulous craftsmanship guarantees consistent, high-quality sound and reliable connection every time.

IMMERSIVE SOUNDSTAGE AND NOISE ISOLATION: By restoring environmental sound effects and blocking out background noise, the SPARK creates an immersive sound environment ideal for gaming, music, and multimedia consumption. Feel fully engaged with your audio, whether you’re in a noisy street or a crowded room.

BROAD COMPATIBILITY WITH MAINSTREAM DEVICES: AUDIOCULAR SPARK is compatible with a wide range of popular devices equipped with Type-C ports. Whether it’s smartphones, tablets, or notebooks, the SPARK delivers flawless audio conversion and amplification across multiple platforms.
